content.title: Dhurandhar 2 box office Day 3: Rs 500 crore worldwide for Ranveer's juggernaut
content.text: Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar: The Revenge has created history for Hindi cinema with its third-day collection alone. As per early estimates from trade website Sacnilk, the spy thriller has amassed a massive Rs 113 crore nett in India on Day 3, taking its three-day total (including previews) to a rock-solid Rs 339.27 crore nett.The global collections are equally impressive, with the film entering the coveted Rs 500 crore club. The overseas gross for Dhurandhar 2 is estimated at Rs 96.50 crore. While the final Day 3 figures are still awaited, the worldwide gross has already reached Rs 501.04 crore. This is not just big - it is historic for Indian cinema.Check the three-day box office breakup of Dhurandhar: The Revenge in India — nett collection (Source: Sacnilk):Day 0 (Wednesday): Rs 43 croreThursday: Rs 102.55 croreFriday: Rs 80.72 croreSaturday: Rs 113 croreTotal: Rs 339.27 croreThe film is reportedly enjoying terrific traction in the North American market (USA & Canada). As per a report by Venky Box Office, its third-day performance is one for the history books. Dhurandhar 2 is running across 4,405 shows in the territory - one of the widest releases for any Indian film there. Even before spot bookings, the film had already sold over two lakh tickets for Day 3, recording a staggering Rs 23.70 crore (approximately) in advance sales alone. The trend suggests that the film could register one of the highest single-day collections for an Indian film in the North American market.A viral post on X also highlighted its performance in the UK, where the film is running in Belfast city with as many as seven houseful shows in a single day.At this pace, Dhurandhar 2's ultimate target is to enter the Rs 2,000 crore club worldwide, and that no longer seems unachievable. Currently, only Dangal (2016) stands as the sole film in that league. Dhurandhar 2 could well become the second Hindi film to join the Aamir Khan starrer.Check the list of highest-grossing Indian films at the worldwide box office — gross collection (Source: Sacnilk):Dangal: Rs 2070 crorePushpa 2: Rs 1742.10 croreBaahubali 2: Rs 1788.06 croreKGF 2: Rs 1215 croreDhurandhar: Rs 1307.35 croreRRR: Rs 1230 croreKalki 2898 AD: Rs 1042.25 croreJawan: Rs 1160 croreKantara Chapter 1: Rs 852.36 croreChhaava: Rs 807.91 croreStree 2: Rs 857.15 croreDhurandhar: The Revenge is expected to surpass Stree 2, Chhaava, Jawan, and even its own predecessor to become the biggest Hindi film globally, with only Dangal left to beat. It will be interesting to see how it continues to shatter records by the end of the Eid weekend. For now, the sky seems to be the limit.Written, directed, and produced by Aditya Dhar, the film features Ranveer Singh as Indian spy Hamza Ali Mazari, who infiltrates Pakistan's criminal-terror networks. The film's politics, technical finesse, and performances have sparked widespread conversation, and that momentum is clearly being reflected in its box office numbers.Dhurandhar: The Revenge also features R Madhavan, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, Rakesh Bedi, Danish Pandor and Sara Arjun, among others.- EndsTOP HEADLINESPublished By: Vineeta KumarPublished On: Mar 21, 2026 23:40 IST
